answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one lotus weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 286 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 132 times the capital for one share. The nebula report reveals the merge explicitly at each orchard. A farm of 4669 identities would post 2618 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
